name: AI Trading Engine
short_description: ML-filtered trading engine where XGBoost predicts P(trade net-profitable after costs). Turned a -₹225k simulated loss into +₹93k profit. 6 parallel strategies on Google Cloud.
detailed_description: An ML-filtered multi-strategy trading system where an XGBoost classifier predicts whether each trade will be net-profitable after transaction costs. Deployed 6 parallel strategies on Google Cloud Platform with PostgreSQL logging of 38,500+ labeled trades. Validated with walk-forward testing across 3 disjoint bull/bear market windows.

analytics: 38,500+ trades labeled with cost-aware net P&L
finance: Walk-forward OOS validated across bear/bull regimes
Live paper trading with broker reconciliation

highlights: ML trade filter turned ₹225k drawdown into +₹93k profit — 95% false-signal reduction
Walk-forward validated across 3 disjoint market windows (bear → consolidation → rally)
Built and deployed scalable infrastructure: XGBoost + FastAPI + GCP Compute Engine + PostgreSQL
Paper trading with broker reconciliation + real-time market data integration
